newsitem.title: POLAND: FORECAST - Polish revrepo rate seen down by end-96.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Polish revrepo rate seen down by end-96.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland's 14-day repo rate, last at 19.14 percent, is expected to fall to 18.59 percent by year end, a Reuter poll of Poland's 25 biggest banks showed.
The forecast is a mean average of banks' predictions ranging from 17.70 to 19.15 percent. Last month, banks had expected the 14-day rate to fall to 18.36 percent by the end of the year.
Banks predicted the rate would average 19.10 percent this month. The forecast range was 18.8 to 19.15 percent. @
By October 1997, banks expected the rate to fall to 16.61 percent. Predictions ranged from 15.22 to 18.15 percent.
